title: Virtual Accounts Dynamic Virtual Account V2

nodes.title: Dynamic Virtual Account Overview
nodes.summary: This module provides APIs to generate and manage a pool of Virtual Accounts, assignable on a transaction-by-transaction basis with configurable parameters like expiry and amount.

nodes.title: Process Flow
nodes.summary: Outlines the necessary steps for merchants to utilize the dynamic virtual account service, from profiling and account creation to transaction initiation and webhook notifications.

nodes.title: API KEYS (Test Environment)
nodes.summary: Provides a three-step guide to obtaining authorization keys in the sandbox environment by creating an account, profiling, and retrieving keys from merchant settings.

nodes.title: Create Dynamic VA Accounts
nodes.summary: This section describes the API to create and assign dynamic virtual accounts to a merchant's pool, generating one account per request.

nodes.title: POST Create Dynamic Virtual Account
nodes.summary: This API endpoint allows creating and assigning a single dynamic virtual account to a merchant's pool.

nodes.title: Instant Settlement
nodes.summary: Instructions to enable instant settlement to a GTBank corporate account by including the beneficiary_account key in the request body.

nodes.title: Custom DVA name
nodes.summary: Describes how authorized merchants can customize the business name for virtual accounts by including first_name and last_name in the request body, ensuring consistency within the account pool.

nodes.title: Initiate Dynamic Virtual Account Transaction
nodes.summary: This section details the API used to retrieve a Dynamic Virtual Account from the available pool for collection, thereby initiating a transaction.

nodes.title: POST Initiate Dynamic Virtual Account Transaction
nodes.summary: This API endpoint retrieves a Dynamic Virtual Account from the pool for assignment to a customer, initiating a transaction.

nodes.title: Re-query Transaction
nodes.summary: This section explains the API for re-querying a transaction to ascertain its status and provides a comprehensive array of all transaction attempts, including those eligible for refunds.

nodes.title: GET Re-query Transaction
nodes.summary: This API endpoint allows re-querying a transaction by its reference to check its status, showing all attempts (SUCCESS, EXPIRED, MISMATCH) and refund eligibility.

nodes.title: Edit Amount/Duration
nodes.summary: This section covers the API used to modify the amount and duration of an already initiated dynamic transaction, requiring the transaction reference, amount, and duration.

nodes.title: PATCH Edit Amount/Duration
nodes.summary: This API endpoint allows modification of the amount and duration for an already initiated dynamic transaction.

nodes.title: Simulate Payment Endpoint
nodes.summary: This section details the API exclusively designed for submitting test transactions within the sandbox environment, including required parameters and responses.

nodes.title: POST Simulate Payment Endpoint
nodes.summary: This API endpoint facilitates submitting test transactions within the sandbox environment, requiring virtual account number, amount, and a DVA flag.

nodes.title: DVA Refunds
nodes.summary: Explains the default automatic refund procedure for mismatched or expired Dynamic Virtual Account (DVA) transactions and outlines options for merchants to receive these funds directly instead.

nodes.title: Process Flow (DVA Refunds)
nodes.summary: Describes the email request process for merchants to choose a preferred settlement location (Dashboard, GTBank Account, or Sub-Merchant Wallet) for mismatched or expired DVA refunds.

nodes.title: Webhooks
nodes.summary: Provides guidance on configuring a webhook URL in the squad dashboard to receive notifications for three transaction events: Success, Mismatch, and Expired, including sample payloads.

nodes.title: Hash Signature Validation
nodes.summary: Details the security requirement for webhook requests to validate a hash signature, generated from specific payload parameters and the secret key, against the x-squad-encrypted-body header.

nodes.title: Sample Implementation (C#)
nodes.summary: Provides a C# code example demonstrating the verification process for webhook hash signatures using HMACSHA512.
